Edward Julian Alexander (born 29 September 2005) is a Liberian professional footballer who plays as a left winger for Mighty Barrolle.
Club career
Early career
Alexander began his senior career in Liberia with Barrack Young Controllers FC, where he made limited first-team appearances between 2022 and 2024.
Watanga FC
In 2024, he moved to Watanga FC, where he gained more regular playing time. During his time at the club, he made nine league appearances and scored one goal.
Mighty Barrolle
In 2025, Alexander signed for Mighty Barrolle. He established himself as a more prominent attacking option, scoring four goals in his first 14 appearances for the club.
International career
Alexander made his debut for the Liberia national football team in September 2025, earning his first cap in a World Cup qualification match against Malawi national football team in Lilongwe.
Playing style
Alexander is known for his pace and direct attacking play. Operating primarily as a left winger, he is recognised for his speed and ability to carry the ball forward in wide areas.
